links.outcome: Precision on two cancer types not used in training, versus trained cancer types
links.effect: Relation-level precision ranged 0.77 to 1.0 for the three trained cancers and 0.83 to 1.0 for breast and prostate cancers without further training.
links.quote: Relation-level precision across the six attributes ranged from 0.77 to 1.0 for the first three cancers and, without further training, 0.83 to 1.0 for two additional cancers.

unlisted_practices: Supervised fine-tuning of an LLM for structured extraction of oncology staging data from clinical notes
Targeted error-pattern training on annotated notes

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM (TLM-Oncology) for retrospective extraction of cancer staging data from clinical text at scale across an integrated health system dataset, but does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
